issues.description: The type of the price field for StockIngredient is inconsistent between the problem statement/solution and the template. The UML and solution use an int price and a constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int), whereas the template declares price as double and a constructor StockIngredient(String, double, int). This mismatch will confuse students about the expected type and constructor signature and can cause type-related compilation or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the UML and solution by changing StockIngredient.price to int, updating the constructor signature to StockIngredient(String, int, int), and changing getPrice() to return int. Alternatively, if int is not desired, update the problem statement and solution to use double consistently; however, aligning the template to int is the least disruptive fix.
